# Metro Parc

## Overview
Metro Parc is a new 559-unit luxury apartment community in Hialeah, FL, located 2 blocks from the Hialeah Metrorail and Tri-Rail Transfer Station. It offers studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments with resort-style amenities.

## Location
- Address: 952 East 26th Street, Hialeah, FL 33013
- 5 min walk to Metrorail / Tri-Rail station
- 20 min to Downtown Miami via Metrorail
- 25 min to Brickell via Metrorail
- 15 min to Health District via Metrorail
- 13 min to Miami International Airport by car
- Walk Score: 73 (Very Walkable)

## Unit Types
- Studios: starting from $1,976/mo
- 1 Bedrooms
- 2 Bedrooms
- Penthouse / The Heights collection

## Amenities
- Resort-style pool with private cabanas
- Modern fitness center with Matrix gear and Peloton bikes
- Co-working space with private booths
- 24-hour concierge service
- Clubroom with entertainment space
- Outdoor courtyard with grills
- High-speed Wi-Fi throughout property
- Controlled-access bike storage
- Amazon lockers for package delivery
- In-unit washer and dryer
- Controlled-access parking
- Ground-floor retail
- Pet-friendly
